title: MOTAT Aviation Hall

terrainReference.basis: Unmodified elevation sampled outside the east public entrance.

mapIdentity.scope: The mapped outline fixes the 60 m by 55 m main hall and the attached eastern volume of approximately 57 m by 37 m. The hall proper is the large rectangle with the uninterrupted north glazing. The wing reaches the current public approach on the east.

note: The north gallery is a glazed heat chimney under a deep, asymmetric aircraft-wing roof. The architect confirms a 42 m unsupported timber span, and the structural supplier documents a 28 m by 9 m hangar opening. The public entrance was upgraded in 2022. The exact photos establish the folded elevations, ventilation bands and glazed door treatment.
